step.cmd: Fact-find with the client using the Farming — Minor in Extent checklist as needed.
Determine if the client was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client was contacted, go to step 5.
If the client was not be contacted or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 letter, go to Reassigning the issue to Level 2 . Reassigning the issue to Level 2

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Details: If completed during fact-finding, copy and paste the Farming — Minor in Extent checklist. To document additional fact-finding details, refer to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
